description: Ministry of Sports - Order to direct Mr. Kaludura Shantha Ruwanchandra de Silva to convene and conduct the Election of Sri Lanka Cricket to elect new office bearers
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Dayasiri Jayasekara, Minister of Sports) and outlines his specific powers and responsibilities under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973 and Gazette (Extraordinary) No. 1825/38. It also contains a specific directive to another named individual (Kaludura Shantha Ruwanchandra de Silva) regarding election procedures, making it a hybrid document with both personnel details and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
